definition: the soft thick hair covering an animal
description: A wooden jetty on a mountain lake. A woman with pink hair holds a paper coffee cup and leans on the boards next to a small brown dachshund, her mouth open in surprise. A very large white mountain dog, soaked from the water, steps onto the jetty and shakes the water out of its thick white coat, the hair standing out in all directions. The woman laughs and covers her mouth while a bearded man behind her strokes the dog.

taps.phrase: to shake its thick white fur
to scurry across the wet boards
